sentences.en: In the first weeks of the Democratic primaries, Bernie Sanders was the only candidate to win big, and to win repeatedly.

sentences.en: We won the popular vote in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 我们在爱荷华州赢得了普选票。

sentences.en: We won the New Hampshire primary.
sentences.zh: 我们赢得了新罕布什尔州的初选。

sentences.en: And according to three networks in the AP, we have now won the Nevada caucus.
sentences.zh: 根据美联社和三家电视网的消息，我们现在已经赢得了内华达州的党团会议。

sentences.en: In Nevada, he did it through sheer popularity by proving he'd built a coalition, one made up of union workers, people with college degrees, and Hispanic voters.
sentences.zh: 在内华达州，他凭借纯粹的人气做到了这一点，证明了他建立了一个由工会成员、大学毕业生和拉美裔选民组成的联盟。

sentences.en: In Iowa and New Hampshire, he did it by narrowly beating out his moderate rivals, who split the majority of the vote with

sentences.zh: 领先的温和派候选人乔·拜登则失去了支持，表现极其糟糕。

sentences.en: The only gas that powers a candidate to the nomination is these delegates.
sentences.zh: 唯一能推动候选人获得提名的燃料就是这些代表票。

sentences.en: And Sanders now has 43 of them.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯现在拥有43张代表票。

sentences.en: And now you can see

sentences.en: All of this left Sanders the frontrunner.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都让桑德斯成为了领跑者。

sentences.zh: 他是今天唯一一个可能以民主党提名人身份走出“超级星期二”的人。

sentences.en: Then came South Carolina.

sentences.zh: 乔·拜登以48%的得票率横扫全场，赢得了该州每一个县，

sentences.zh: 以超过二比一的优势碾压伯尼·桑德斯，其他人则远远落后。

sentences.zh: 拜登的大胜帮助他大幅缩小了与桑德斯之间的代表票差距。

sentences.en: It's very close.

sentences.zh: 但南卡罗来纳州的初选仅仅是在三天前。

sentences.zh: 谁的心肠更好一点？

sentences.en: Who has the money to be able to do this?

sentences.zh: 但拜登在南卡罗来纳州的表现，对我来说是转折点。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: I didn't believe he was going to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 我不相信他能做到这一点。

sentences.en: I didn't believe him when he said, it's a firewall.
sentences.zh: 当他说这是防火墙时，我不相信他。

sentences.en: And the numbers are unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 而且数字令人难以置信。

sentences.en: It's like, wow, Joe did it.
sentences.zh: 就像，哇，乔做到了。

sentences.en: So then you come back to Bloomberg and it's like, well, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以当你回到布隆伯格身上时，感觉就像，嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: It sounds like the thing that matters most to you was just victory.
sentences.zh: 听起来对你来说最重要的是胜利。

sentences.en: Is seeing Joe Biden, this person who was faltering on stage, you didn't like the way he was presenting, suddenly seeming electable because he had won an election.
sentences.zh: 看到乔·拜登，这个在台上动摇的人，你不喜欢他的表现方式，却因为他赢得了一场选举，突然看起来有胜算了。

sentences.en: It's no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: The winning was really important.
sentences.zh: 获胜真的很重要。

sentences.en: But that speech.
sentences.zh: 但那次演讲。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.

sentences.en: South Carolina.

sentences.en: Really grabbed me.
sentences.zh: 真的打动了我。

sentences.en: Let me talk directly to Democrats across America, especially those who will be voting on Super Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 让我直接对全美的民主党人说，特别是那些将在超级星期二投票的人。

sentences.en: And it was hopeful and it laid out an agenda.
sentences.zh: 那次演讲充满希望，并提出了议程。

sentences.en: Democrats want to nominate someone who will build on Obamacare, not scrap it.
sentences.zh: 民主党人想要提名一个能在奥巴马医改基础上建设，而不是废除它的人。

sentences.en: Take.
sentences.zh: 对抗。

sentences.en: Take on the NRA gun manufacturers, not protect them.
sentences.zh: 对抗全国步枪协会和枪支制造商，而不是保护他们。

sentences.en: Stand up and give the poor fighting chance for the middle class to get restored, not raise their taxes and make, keep the promises we make.
sentences.zh: 站出来，给穷人一个奋斗的机会，让中产阶级得到恢复，而不是增加他们的税收，并信守我们做出的承诺。

sentences.en: Then join us.
sentences.zh: 那就加入我们。

sentences.en: And if the Democrats want a nominee who's a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 如果民主党人想要一个民主党候选人。

sentences.en: Democrat.
sentences.zh: 民主党人。

sentences.en: Democrat.
sentences.zh: 民主党人。

sentences.en: And so now he's back.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他回来了。

sentences.en: So here's the deal.
sentences.zh: 所以情况是这样的。

sentences.en: Let's get back up.
sentences.zh: 让我们重新振作起来。

sentences.en: We're decent.
sentences.zh: 我们是正派的。

sentences.en: We're brave.
sentences.zh: 我们是勇敢的。

sentences.en: We're resilient people.
sentences.zh: 我们是坚韧的人民。

sentences.en: We can't believe again.
sentences.zh: 我们不能再次相信。

sentences.en: And we're better than this moment.
sentences.zh: 我们比这个时刻更好。

sentences.en: We're better than this president.
sentences.zh: 我们比这位总统更好。

sentences.en: So get up.
sentences.zh: 所以站起来。

sentences.en: Take back our country.
sentences.zh: 夺回我们的国家。

sentences.en: This is the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 这是美利坚合众国。

sentences.en: There's nothing beyond our capacity if we do it together.
sentences.zh: 如果我们齐心协力，没有什么能难倒我们。

sentences.en: God bless you all.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: And may God protect our troops.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑我们的军队。

sentences.en: So at the moment, this is Sunday night, almost nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 所以现在是周日晚上，快九点了。

sentences.en: You are leaning toward Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 你倾向于支持乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What are the odds that you change your mind between now and Super Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 从现在到超级星期二，你改变主意的几率有多大？

sentences.en: It's really amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真的很神奇。

sentences.en: Because I'm just so back and forth and back and forth every day and every hour of every day.
sentences.zh: 因为我每天、每小时都在反复纠结。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about what I'm hearing you say, because I think this is a larger question happening in Virginia on Super Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈我听到的你的说法，因为我认为这是弗吉尼亚州在超级星期二发生的一个更大的问题。

sentences.en: And a part of the reason why we're here, which is that it seems like aside from defeating Trump, which is your number one priority,
sentences.zh: 我们在这里的部分原因是，除了击败特朗普（这是你的首要任务）之外，

sentences.en: a big priority for you is not having Bernie Sanders be the nominee.
sentences.zh: 你的一个大目标是不让伯尼·桑德斯成为候选人。

sentences.en: But is that fair to say?
sentences.zh: 这样说公平吗？

sentences.en: A equals B and B equals C.
sentences.zh: A等于B，B等于C。

sentences.en: Because if my number one issue is to beat Trump, then we need the candidate who can do that.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我的首要问题是击败特朗普，那么我们需要能做到这一点的候选人。

sentences.en: So that's really the calculus that's happening here.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是这里正在进行的计算。

sentences.en: But I'm hearing you waffling over these two moderate candidates, Biden and Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 但我听到你在拜登和布隆伯格这两位温和派候选人之间摇摆不定。

sentences.en: And the latest polling has Sanders with close to what he had in 2016 in Arlington.
sentences.zh: 最新的民调显示，桑德斯在阿灵顿的支持率接近他2016年的水平。

sentences.en: Biden and Bloomberg are around 20% too, because they're sharing a lot of voters.
sentences.zh: 拜登和布隆伯格也在20%左右，因为他们分流了很多选民。

sentences.en: So if on Super Tuesday, Sanders sweeps a bunch of these states and he wins in places like Virginia, it will likely have been because Biden and Bloomberg split the vote.
sentences.zh: 所以如果在超级星期二，桑德斯横扫了这些州，并在弗吉尼亚州等地获胜，那很可能是因为拜登和布隆伯格分流了选票。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you're thinking about that at all.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否考虑过这一点。

sentences.en: I am thinking about that.
sentences.zh: 我正在考虑这一点。

sentences.en: I think every other election has been like, oh, I don't I don't watch the polls.
sentences.zh: 我想以前的每次选举都像是，哦，我不看民调。

sentences.en: I just vote.
sentences.zh: 我只是投票。

sentences.en: You know, I vote my heart.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我凭心投票。

sentences.en: I vote my I vote the issues, you know.
sentences.zh: 我投票，我根据议题投票，你知道。

sentences.en: But now we're all watching the polls.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们都在看民调。

sentences.en: We're all kind of gaming.
sentences.zh: 我们都在博弈。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We all think we're on CNN.
sentences.zh: 我们都以为自己在CNN上。

sentences.en: And it's like, this is crazy.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: But we feel like we have to because the end game is which of these candidates can beat Trump.
sentences.zh: 但我们觉得必须这样做，因为最终目标是这些候选人中谁能击败特朗普。

sentences.en: And that's why.
sentences.zh: 这就是原因。

sentences.en: So I'm going to be looking at the polls and I may actually delay my actual vote on Tuesday until like usually I vote before I go to work.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算看看民调，我甚至可能会推迟周二的实际投票，通常我会在上班前投票。

sentences.en: But I may vote after work, depending on afternoon polling or, you know, because if I want to vote for the candidate,
sentences.zh: 但我可能会在下班后投票，取决于下午的民调，或者，你知道，因为如果我想投票给那个候选人，

sentences.en: if it looks like Virginia can, let's see if I can say this right.
sentences.zh: 如果看起来弗吉尼亚州能，让我看看能不能说对。

sentences.en: Sorry for the.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: But if it looks like Bloomberg and Biden are if one of them is going to knock off Sanders in Virginia, I will vote for who can do that.
sentences.zh: 但如果看起来布隆伯格和拜登中有一个能击败桑德斯，我会投给能做到那一点的人。

sentences.en: So to be clear, Brian is saying that on election day, he is going to watch the early results come in before he goes to place his own vote.
sentences.zh: 所以明确一下，布莱恩是说在选举日，他会先看早期的结果，然后再去投票。

sentences.en: And his logic is that he's going to try to limit the chance that a moderate split would lead to a Sanders win in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 他的逻辑是，他要尽量减少温和派分票导致桑德斯在弗吉尼亚州获胜的可能性。

sentences.en: I think I'm being part of the solution because I'm putting so much frigging effort into this thing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我正在成为解决方案的一部分，因为我在这件事上投入了太多该死的努力。

sentences.en: I mean, it's unbelievable, you know, and it is.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这简直令人难以置信，你知道，事实确实如此。

sentences.en: It's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: And I think actually so many people are in my neighborhood and my friends, like it's really amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，实际上我周围的很多人，还有我的朋友们，都觉得这真的很了不起。

sentences.en: And there are people saying, like, so what should I do?
sentences.zh: 还有人会问，比如，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: What am I?
sentences.zh: 我算什么？

sentences.en: And they're really thinking this through.
sentences.zh: 他们真的在认真思考这个问题。

sentences.en: As Brian is talking, what he's describing about the efforts that he and his friends and his neighbors are making is reminding me of what happened to the Republicans back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩在谈话时，他所描述的他和他的朋友及邻居们所做的努力，让我想起了2016年共和党发生的事情。

sentences.en: During the same time that year, the establishment was paralyzed by Donald Trump's success with voters in the primaries.
sentences.zh: 那年同期，建制派被唐纳德·特朗普在初选中的选民支持率所瘫痪。

sentences.en: They were terrified of it, but they didn't really know what to do about it and kind of did nothing really.
sentences.zh: 他们对此感到恐惧，但真的不知道该怎么办，实际上什么也没做。

sentences.en: And then Trump basically ran away with Super Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普基本上在“超级星期二”大获全胜。

sentences.en: And after that, by the time party leaders got organized and tried to stop him, it was too late.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，等党内领导人组织起来试图阻止他时，已经太晚了。

sentences.en: And people like Brian are a bit like the Democratic version of the Never Trump movement.
sentences.zh: 像布莱恩这样的人，有点像是民主党版的“反特朗普”运动。

sentences.en: They see Sanders as the Trump of the left.
sentences.zh: 他们把桑德斯视为左翼的特朗普。

sentences.en: And they're trying to do everything within their power to avoid that from happening on their side.
sentences.zh: 他们正竭尽全力避免这种情况在他们党内发生。

sentences.en: I keep thinking about the way you've talked about Sanders and the risk he poses to the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考你谈论桑德斯的方式，以及他给民主党带来的风险。

sentences.en: If Sanders becomes the nominee, if it came down to it in a general election, Sanders versus Trump, what would you do?
sentences.zh: 如果桑德斯成为候选人，如果最终在大选中对决，桑德斯对阵特朗普，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: So, for me, that's really going to depend on his number two.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，这真的要取决于他的副手人选。

sentences.en: There's an automatic, I'm going to be voting for the Democrat coming out of your mouth right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在脱口而出的话里，有一种自动的“我会投票给民主党人”的意味。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I might take some solace in a youthful vice president who, you know, Elizabeth Warren could get me for sure.
sentences.zh: 如果有一位年轻的副总统，我可能会感到些许安慰，你知道，伊丽莎白·沃伦肯定能争取到我。

sentences.en: Do you ever think you'd be in the position of imagining the frontrunner in the Democratic presidential primary being a person that you can't instantly say I'd vote for?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过，自己会处于这样一种境地：想象着民主党总统初选的领跑者，竟然是一个你无法立刻说出“我会投票给他”的人？

sentences.en: I could never imagine that the Democrats would nominate someone who's not a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 我从来没想过民主党会提名一个非民主党人。

sentences.en: So that's really the answer.
sentences.zh: 所以这才是真正的答案。

sentences.en: Do you think that it's inevitably hard for someone who lives in a community of, you know,
sentences.zh: 你认为对于一个生活在，你知道，

sentences.en: expensive houses in suburban Virginia to ever really understand why people might want to break the system?
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州郊区昂贵住宅区的人来说，去真正理解为什么人们想要打破这个体制，是不是必然很困难？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I totally understand why people would want to break the system.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解为什么人们想要打破这个体制。

sentences.en: And I really know the system doesn't work for so many people.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实知道这个体制对很多人来说并不奏效。

sentences.en: I mean, millions and millions of people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，成千上万的人。

sentences.en: And that it's not a perfect union.
sentences.zh: 而且它并不是一个完美的联邦。

sentences.en: I mean, it really isn't.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它确实不是。

sentences.en: But we are trying to create a perfect union.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在努力创造一个完美的联邦。

sentences.en: That's kind of the beauty of the country.
sentences.zh: 这正是这个国家的魅力所在。

sentences.en: To use the language of revolution, it's not responsible, it's not helpful, it's not really what we should be doing, especially against Trump.
sentences.zh: 用革命的语言来说，这是不负责任的，没有帮助的，也不是我们真正应该做的，尤其是在对抗特朗普的时候。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much for your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Today, I am ending my campaign and endorsing Joe Biden for president.
sentences.zh: 今天，我结束了我的竞选活动，并支持乔·拜登竞选总统。

sentences.en: I'm delighted to endorse and support Joe Biden for president.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能支持乔·拜登竞选总统。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, March 3rd, 2020, I will be casting my ballot for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 明天，2020年3月3日，我将把票投给乔·拜登。

sentences.en: On Monday night, three former Democratic candidates for president endorsed Joe Biden simultaneously in a show of force by the party's moderate wing
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，三位前民主党总统候选人同时宣布支持乔·拜登，展示了党内温和派的力量，

sentences.en: as they seek to block Bernie Sanders from becoming the nominee.
sentences.zh: 因为他们试图阻止伯尼·桑德斯成为候选人。

sentences.en: I believe, and it's the reason I'm up here, that we are never going to out-divide the divider-in-chief.
sentences.zh: 我相信，这也是我站在这里的原因，我们永远无法在分裂上胜过那位“总分裂师”。

sentences.en: Because if we spend the next four months dividing our party and going at each other, we will spend the next four years watching Donald Trump tear apart this country.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们花未来四个月的时间来分裂我们的党并互相攻击，我们将花未来四年的时间看着唐纳德·特朗普撕裂这个国家。

sentences.en: At a rally in Texas, one of the 14 states to hold its primary today, Amy Klobuchar, who had dropped out of the race hours before,
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州的一场集会上，这是今天举行初选的14个州之一，艾米·克洛布查尔，她在几小时前退出了竞选，

sentences.en: was joined by Pete Buttigieg, who dropped out a day earlier, and Beto O'Rourke, who left the race in November.
sentences.zh: 与前一天退出的皮特·布蒂吉格，以及去年11月退出的贝托·奥罗克一同出席。

sentences.en: We need somebody who can beat Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个能打败唐纳德·特朗普的人。

sentences.en: Sanders, appearing on CNN, dismissed the endorsements and suggested that they would have little impact.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯在CNN上露面时，驳回了这些背书，并暗示它们不会产生什么影响。

sentences.en: From day one, we have been taking on the establishment.
sentences.zh: 从第一天起，我们就一直在挑战建制派。

sentences.en: And let me be very clear, it is no surprise, they do not want me to become president.
sentences.zh: 让我说清楚，这并不令人惊讶，他们不希望我成为总统。

sentences.en: Because our administration will transform this country to create an economy and a government that works for all of the people.
sentences.zh: 因为我们的政府将改造这个国家，创造一个为所有人服务的经济和政府。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 冠状病毒现在已经感染了除南极洲以外的每一个大洲的人。

sentences.zh: 但全球卫生官员表示，个别国家仍有可能控制住疫情。

sentences.en: But in doing that, you're accepting that you can no longer affect the course of the disease.
sentences.zh: 但这样做，你就等于承认你无法再影响疾病的进程。

sentences.en: You can no longer change the shape of the epidemic.
sentences.zh: 你无法再改变疫情的走向。

sentences.en: And you're purely moving in that sense to save as many lives as you can.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，你纯粹是在尽力挽救尽可能多的生命。

sentences.en: Now, WHO does not believe that we're there yet.
sentences.zh: 现在，世卫组织认为我们还没有到那一步。

sentences.en: During a news conference, the leaders of the World Health Organization said that the time for such containment was running out
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，世界卫生组织的领导人表示，采取这种遏制措施的时间正在流逝，

sentences.en: and urged countries to take every possible precaution.
sentences.zh: 并敦促各国采取一切可能的预防措施。

sentences.en: And if we're lucky and if we do the job really well, we may get the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 如果我们幸运的话，如果我们工作做得非常好，我们可能会得到机会。

sentences.en: We just might get the opportunity to interrupt transmission.
sentences.zh: 我们可能刚好有机会阻断传播。

sentences.en: In Europe, the EU raised its alert level from moderate to high as the number of infections surged, reaching 18 of the EU's 27 nations.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，随着感染人数激增，欧盟将警戒级别从“中等”提高到“高”，波及欧盟27个国家中的18个。

sentences.en: In South Korea, infections have doubled since Friday to more than 4,300.
sentences.zh: 在韩国，感染人数自周五以来翻了一番，超过了4300人。

sentences.en: And in the U.S., as of Monday night, authorities had reported 100 cases and, in Washington state, six deaths from the virus.
sentences.zh: 在美国，截至周一晚上，当局已报告了100例病例，在华盛顿州，有6人死于该病毒。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我是莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》，在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
